answer: Require each new identity to post a 50-unit escrow bond that unlocks only after five verified trades with five different established counterparties. A sybil farm cannot self-deal: trades with the same vertex or its own clones do not count, and each trade must pass an onyx-anchored receipt check that a prism of independent witnesses can re-verify. For 1,000 fakes an attacker must lock 50,000 units and complete 5,000 genuine trades, while a single honest agent pays once and unlocks its bond; a caught fake loses the whole bond.
